pairs.subject: usage-aggregation-semantics
pairs.evidence: src/features/overview/sub_usage/libs/periodComparison.ts:2 This context only displays usage. It overlays the previous period's flow values (tokens, runs, cost, latency) as ghost lines on a chart and never folds events into a stored per-customer, per-period quantity for an invoice. A case-insensitive search of src/features/overview/sub_usage/ for invoice, billing, subscription, seat, licence/license, recurring, integral and high-water/watermark found nothing, so the subject's metered-billing precondition does not hold.

techniques.evidence: src/features/overview/sub_usage/libs/periodComparison.ts:2 Nothing here issues a charge at event time or at period close. The period logic is a chart overlay, so there is no ratchet to keep.

src/features/overview/sub_usage/libs/chartConstants.ts:34 Every metric unit is a flow or a measurement (count, tokens, usd, ms, percent). No held level is charted, so there is nothing to integrate over time.
src/features/overview/sub_usage/components/ToolPerformancePanel.tsx:31 Counts are counts of invocations (chargeable acts), not identifiers held through add/remove operations.
src/features/overview/sub_usage/libs/periodComparison.ts:77 Each period is window-closed per-day flow data. A quiet day has no carried-over level, so no period-crossing seed exists.
